input.quote: 30. FORCE MAJEURE. TrueLink will be excused from delays in performing or from failing to perform its obligations under this Agreement to the extent the delays or failures result from causes beyond the reasonable control or TrueLink.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance provision (search for "insurance" returns nothing; the general provisions run from Section 15 through Section 30 with no coverage requirement), even though TrueLink hosts our Web Site and processes Client Content and Credit Data (consumer credit information). Playbook requires standard vendor coverages, including E&O and cyber/privacy, for vendors touching Customer Data. Inserted a new Section 31 after the final general provision (Force Majeure, p0097) requiring CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M and statutory workers' compensation, with certificates on request; fallback of E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert new Section 31 requiring TrueLink to carry CGL, E&O, cyber and workers' compensation insurance and to provide certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance provision even though TrueLink hosts our Web Site and handles Client Content and Credit Data, so we have added our standard coverages (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation) with certificates on request. If USD 5M cyber is not available, we can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M.

ops.text: 31. INSURANCE. TrueLink shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 covering TrueLink's hosting, processing, storage and transmission of Client Content, Credit Data and other Client data; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. TrueLink shall provide Client with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
